title: Let’s have a Chat with the EU AI Act
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of a chatbot using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to assist developers in navigating the EU AI Act. While it mentions ethical principles (e.g., transparency, fairness) as part of the regulatory landscape it helps navigate, it does not evaluate or benchmark the internal moral reasoning, religious views, or ethical values of the LLM itself.
